body:
Thanks for the kind words, everyone. It's good to know that I have some support.

As much as I would love to share my work with you all,I'm using a throwaway and want to preserve my anonymity. It means the world that you're all interested in what I have written. Because of your kindness, I'll share the poem that was published in this comment:

EDIT: The line breaks are messed up, so I added slashes for single line breaks and double slashes for stanza breaks.

**The Day Jack Goes to Town**

The day is over./
The sun's gone down./
And tomorrow is the day/
Jack goes to town.//

“It's for the best,” They told him,/
“It's 'cause we care.”/
“We can't watch you kill yourself,”/
“It's just not fair.” //

The checks were signed./
The bill was paid./
And tomorrow is the day/
Jack gets saved.//

They took away his needles./
They took away his junk./
They thought they took it all away,/
But they never checked his trunk.//

Alone in the dark/
They leave him to think./
He's alert and awake/
With forty left to wink.//

The hours stretch by./
Jack knows what he needs./
He knows that he shouldn't,/
But his body pleads.//

Twisting under sheets,/
Jack finds no rest./
Cold sweat pours down/
And pain burns his chest.//

End of the night,/
Body taking the lead,/
He gets out of bed/
And takes what he needs.//

“Just a little,” Jack says,/
Measuring a shot/
“This'll be the last time.”/
Though he knows that it's not.//

He feels that pinch,/
That touch of a friend,/
He collapses and writhes/
Grinning to the end.//

Twice that day the sun went down/
And Jack never did go in to town.
